title: Updated estimates of post-merger gravitational wave energy released in GW170817 and the maximum neutron star mass
summary: In this work, benefiting from the increased sample of neutron stars with measured masses and radii as well as the incorporation of the chiral effective field theory and perturbative QCD constraints, the tidal parameter $κ_2^T$ is constrained to be $78^{+17}_{-11}$ (68.3% credible interval, mainly adopted in this work unless mentioned specifically) for the binary neutron stars involved in GW170817. Such a $κ_2^T$ is in favor of strong gravitational wave radiation in the post-merger phase and the corresponding energy is estimated to be $E_{\rm GW,p} \simeq 0.051^{+0.022}_{-0.017}\,M_\odot…
